title: Session recaps in the journal
summary: Each played session now has a Recap: a short summary of what happened, worked out from the session's records, that the DM can edit and share with the party.
items: The recap groups loot and coin awarded, treasure-pool claims resolved, purchases and sales per shop, travel, and downtime and services, with amounts in gp, sp and cp.
Players see a recap built only from what they can already see: never other players' purses or the DM's private records.
The DM's draft for the players leaves out NPCs, hidden characters and DM-only records. Sharing posts it once as a party journal entry.
Older sessions get a recap too, from their recorded entries, or show Nothing recorded.
